title: Made-in China, Thinking in America: U.S. Values Persist in Chinese LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM responses on the Moral Foundations Questionnaire 2.0 (MFQ-2) and the World Values Survey (WVS) to human survey responses from American and Chinese populations using cosine similarity.

Assigning American or Chinese national identity personas in system prompts and comparing the output of models developed in China versus the USA to evaluate alignment with specific national human populations.
Administering the moral and value surveys in both English and Chinese to test whether the prompt language mitigates or shifts the models' skew toward Western values.
